description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: CATL-inspired Na-ion Prismatic Cell
cell.source: Tremblay & Dessaint (2009) framework; CATL first-gen Na-ion; Slater et al. (2013), Adv. Funct. Mater.
cell.chemistry: Na-ion (layered oxide cathode / hard carbon anode)

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Adapted from Tremblay & Dessaint (2009); CATL Na-ion press release data

E_a.source: Estimated from Na-ion impedance data; Hwang et al. (2017), Chem. Soc. Rev., 46, 3529

alpha_c.note: Capacity temperature coefficient (Na-ion slightly more temp-sensitive)
alpha_c.source: Estimated; Rudola et al. (2021), J. Mater. Chem. A, 9, 8279
